REFUTED IF: the turn cannot surface the deleted edge — it answers that there is nothing deleted, asks the author for a link id (the workaround the defect forces), or calls composition_list_outline WITHOUT include_archived and reports an empty set. Any of those is the defect, live.

CONFIRMED IF: the turn calls composition_list_outline with include_archived=true and the archived edge comes back in `scene_links`, so the author can name it.

🔴 THE READ IS TIER R AND THE TURN MUST NOT WRITE. This scenario proves DISCOVERY only. Whether the model then goes on to call `restore` is a SEPARATE question this loop already tracks — the sibling family measured restore called on 0 of 5 runs, with the model correctly asking which candidate to restore when several exist. A run that discovers the edge and stops is a PASS here.
